sponsored.t: Requires the office for the aging to make an annual report on the budget expenditures on behalf of the senior population of the state
sponsored.sum: Requires the office for the aging to make an annual report on the budget expenditures on behalf of the senior population of the state every April first.

sponsored.t: Requires an annual report on individuals who are the primary caregiver for an older adult
sponsored.sum: Requires a report on individuals who are the primary caregiver for an older adult, including the number of individuals who are primary caregivers for an older adult, the average age of a primary caregiver, the cost to an individual to provide care to an older adult, and the economic value and savings to the state of such individual's services.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the expanded pharmaceutical insurance coverage panel
sponsored.sum: Relates to improving and expanding the pharmaceutical insurance coverage program for certain medicare enrollees; creates the expanded pharmaceutical insurance coverage panel, to be responsible for expanding pharmaceutical insurance coverage.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "independent senior housing resident freedom of choice act" to authorize persons in independent housing to receive services they could get at home
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "independent senior housing resident freedom of choice act" to authorize persons in independent housing, shelters and residences to receive services they could otherwise receive if they resided in a private residence.

sponsored.t: Establishes an elder financial exploitation public awareness campaign
sponsored.sum: Establishes an elder financial exploitation public awareness campaign to educate older adults and persons providing care to older adults on the prevention and detection of financial exploitation.

sponsored.t: Establishes the adult care facility voucher demonstration program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the adult care facility voucher demonstration program for persons with dementia, Alzheimer's diagnosis, or other cognitive impairments to provide a sliding-scale subsidy for adult care facility residents who are at risk of losing nursing home care due to depleted resources and to individuals who are not eligible for Medicaid or supplemental security income, but in need of adult day care services.

sponsored.t: Requires certain motion picture theaters to provide scheduled showings of motion pictures with open motion picture captioning
sponsored.sum: Requires a motion picture theater that offers more than ten motion picture showings per week to provide scheduled showings of motion pictures with open motion picture captioning such that at least one quarter of all showings of a motion picture with four or more showings during a one-week time period shall have open motion picture captioning; provides exceptions and penalties for violations.

sponsored.t: Establishes certification and attestation for care managers employed by care coordination organizations
sponsored.sum: Enacts "Ella's law"; requires care managers employed by or under contract with a care coordination organization to provide care management services to an individual unless such care manager has completed all training requirements.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain jury awards in employment discrimination actions
sponsored.sum: Provides that the court shall not reduce jury awards as excessive in employment discrimination actions unless the court finds exceptional circumstances which compel the conclusion that the jury was influenced by partiality, prejudice, mistake or corruption or that remittitur or additur is necessary to avoid a complete miscarriage of justice.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring insurers participating in the NY state of health marketplace to offer at least one dental plan for individuals age 65 and older
sponsored.sum: Requires insurers participating in the NY state of health marketplace to offer at least one dental plan for individuals age 65 and older.

sponsored.t: Establishes the caregiver coordinating commission
sponsored.sum: Establishes the caregiver coordinating commission to review and evaluate statewide planning, development, and implementation of caregiver support services, including respite care, for informal family caregivers caring for those across the lifespan.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting other qualifying members of a household to qualify for the disability rent increase exemption
sponsored.sum: Permits other qualifying members of a household to qualify the household for the disability rent increase exemption when they are not the head of household.

sponsored.t: Relates to peripheral artery disease
sponsored.sum: Requires insurance coverage for peripheral artery disease.

sponsored.t: Relates to directing the metropolitan transportation authority to establish a city university of New York student fare program
sponsored.sum: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to establish a city university of New York student fare program for trains and buses which provides a full fare reduction for five train and/or bus fares each weekday equal to the standard pay-per-ride fare.

sponsored.t: Relates to dementia care navigators and coordinators
sponsored.sum: Requires each designated agency to employ a dementia care navigator to provide support for caregivers of individuals with dementia and to assist individuals with dementia in accessing appropriate services; requires the state office for the aging to establish the position of dementia care coordinator.

sponsored.t: Establishes a state master plan on aging dashboard
sponsored.sum: Requires the state office for the aging to maintain a public facing state master plan on aging dashboard on the public website of the office, which includes real-time information and updates on each proposal in such master plan including legislative and budgetary progress.

sponsored.t: Establishes the interagency council on kinship care
sponsored.sum: Establishes the interagency council on kinship care to investigate, evaluate and make recommendations concerning the unique issues of kinship caregivers.

sponsored.t: Relates to paid leave for menopause
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing five days of paid leave for menopause.

sponsored.t: Establishes a pilot program for schools with active aging programs or specializations in place
sponsored.sum: Establishes a pilot program for schools with active aging programs or specializations in place; creates a curriculum team that shall identify areas that are most relevant to persons working with older adults currently, and/or represent emerging and evidenced-based practices and create a suggested syllabus template for an advanced-year practice class in the field of aging; creates the workforce development center for professional development in gerontological/geriatric education.

sponsored.t: Requires employers to provide a leave of absence for an employee to use for preventative health care measures
sponsored.sum: Requires employers to provide a leave of absence of at least four hours for every 12 month period for an employee to use for preventative health care measures.

sponsored.t: Requires employers to provide a leave of absence for an employee to use for menopause
sponsored.sum: Requires employers to provide leave of absence of at least five days for every 12 month period for an employee to use for menopause symptoms; requires the commissioner of labor, in consultation with the commissioner of health, to develop workplace guidance relating to menopause.

sponsored.t: Requires employers to provide a leave of absence for an employee to use for colon cancer screenings
sponsored.sum: Requires employers to provide a leave of absence of at least four hours for every 12 month period for an employee to use for colon cancer screenings.

sponsored.t: Directs the office of children and family services to conduct a statewide needs assessment
sponsored.sum: Directs the office of children and family services to conduct a statewide needs assessment to identify any unmet needs, including, but not limited to, housing, mental health access, financial assistance, childcare, and respite care access for kinship caregivers.

sponsored.t: Establishes a caregiver tax credit and a family caregiver reimbursement program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a caregiver tax credit of up to six thousand dollars and a family caregiver reimbursement program to offset out-of-pocket spending by family caregivers.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the creation of state debt in the amount of 5 billion dollars in creating the New York state master plan on aging 2026 bond act
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the creation of state debt in the amount of 5 billion dollars in creating the New York state master plan on aging 2026 bond act; provides for submission to the people of such proposal.

sponsored.t: Establishes the office of New York state benefits coordination
sponsored.sum: Establishes the office of New York state benefits coordination to document and track all benefit programs in the state, and establish a state benefits portal and universal benefits application.

sponsored.t: Establishes a temporary commission to study the environmental and health effects of evolving 5G technology
sponsored.sum: Establishes a temporary commission to study the environmental and health effects of evolving 5G technology.

sponsored.t: Relates to courses of study in consumer awareness and financial education
sponsored.sum: Requires any school district in the state shall provide, to pupils in grades nine through twelve, one full unit of instruction designed to promote consumer awareness and financial education.

sponsored.t: Provides for an optional excuse from jury service for persons age 70 and over
sponsored.sum: Provides for an optional excuse from jury service for persons age 70 and over.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of consent
sponsored.sum: Adds the definition of consent to the terms of general use; defines it as a freely given, knowledgeable and informed agreement by a person with the capacity to reason.

sponsored.t: Relates to proceedings in family court
sponsored.sum: Relates to proceedings in family court; requires all transcripts of proceedings or hearings in family court shall be provided to the parties within five days of such proceeding or hearing; requires attorneys for children shall meet monthly with both parents or guardians and submit a report, including, but not limited to each meeting, the non-confidential, substantive portion of any meetings and any communications with the parties and the child or children; increases the compensation of assigned counsel from $158 to $200 and the total amount of reimbursement from $10,000 to $20,000; authorizes the right of a trial by jury for matters of fact in family court proceedings.

sponsored.t: Includes second degree relatives in certain criteria for breast cancer screenings to be covered under insurance plans
sponsored.sum: Provides that individuals may receive breast cancer screenings under an insurance plan when such individual has a second degree relative with a prior history of breast cancer.

sponsored.t: Relates to mandatory training curriculum
sponsored.sum: Relates to mandatory training curriculum for election commissioners and key staff of boards of elections.

sponsored.t: Requires LGBT awareness curriculum or instruction
sponsored.sum: Requires LGBT awareness curriculum or instruction.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain deceptive acts and practices and the court's jurisdiction over such acts and practices
sponsored.sum: Provides that any claim for deceptive acts or practices against a distribution utility providing gas, electric or steam services to the public, the court shall have exclusive jurisdiction over such claim without regard to any defenses alleged; provides that in any claim for false advertising, the court shall have exclusive jurisdiction over such claim.

sponsored.t: Provides a limitation on actions to collect overcharges
sponsored.sum: Provides that an action to recover the amount of an overcharge based upon a mistake or billing error made by an electric, gas or telephone corporation must be commenced within ten years.

sponsored.t: Relates to leaving the scene of an accident involving an electric scooter or bicycle with an electric assist system without reporting in the first and second degrees
sponsored.sum: Increases the penalties for leaving the scene of an accident involving an electric scooter without reporting in the second degree and leaving the scene of an accident involving an electric scooter without reporting in the first degree; provides increased penalties for leaving the scene of an accident involving a wheeled non-motorized means of conveyance without reporting in the first and second degrees when the vehicle involved is a bicycle with an electric assist system.

sponsored.t: Includes nurse practitioners as a provider of services for purposes of collaborative drug therapy management and makes the authorization for pharmacists to perform such management permanent
sponsored.sum: Includes nurse practitioners as a provider of services for purposes of collaborative drug therapy management; makes the authorization for pharmacists to perform such management permanent.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the commissioner of health to adopt policies to exclude certain non-recurring items from income for the program for elderly pharmaceutical insurance cover
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the commissioner of health to adopt policies to exclude certain non-recurring items from income that would artificially inflate the availability of funds to meet current needs relating to eligibility for the program for elderly pharmaceutical insurance coverage.

sponsored.t: Relates to informal caregiver training
sponsored.sum: Relates to informal caregiver training; defines "person in need of assistance"; expands who may serve as an "informal caregiver".

sponsored.t: Establishes the aging in place task force, and provides for its powers and duties
sponsored.sum: Establishes the aging in place task force to study how the state can encourage aging in place; provides for its powers and duties.

sponsored.t: Provides for certain tickets purchased for use on the Long Island Rail Road or the Metro-North Commuter Railroad Company to be valid at any time during the day or night
sponsored.sum: Provides that any one-way, round trip or multi-trip tickets purchased for use on the Long Island Rail Road or the Metro-North Commuter Railroad Company by a senior citizen or a person with a disability shall be valid at any time during the day or night.

sponsored.t: Relates to allowing for students in postsecondary education experience or transition program to receive awards from the tuition assistance program
sponsored.sum: Relates to allowing for students in certain postsecondary education experience or transition programs to receive awards from the tuition assistance program.

sponsored.t: Requires that instruction in public schools aligned to the Culturally Responsive-Sustaining Education Framework
sponsored.sum: Requires instruction in public schools aligned to the Culturally Responsive-Sustaining Education Framework; requires the commissioner of education to update learning standards on an ongoing basis and provide technical assistance and resources to aid public schools in providing such instruction.

sponsored.t: Establishes protections for eligible adults from financial exploitation
sponsored.sum: Establishes protections for adults sixty years of age or older, or at least the age of eighteen and who, because of mental or physical impairments, are unable to manage their own resources or protect themselves from financial exploitation without assistance from others.

sponsored.t: Establishes a direct support wage enhancement to employees that provide direct care support or any other form of treatment, to individuals with developmental disabilities
sponsored.sum: Establishes a direct support wage enhancement to employees that provide direct care support or any other form of treatment, to individuals with developmental disabilities and whose income is less than $125,000.

sponsored.t: Permits special education services and programs for preschool children with handicapping conditions to establish reserve funds
sponsored.sum: Permits special education services and programs for preschool children with handicapping conditions to establish reserve funds.

sponsored.t: Provides for due process procedures for certain persons who have received an offer for transitional care or certain care prior to becoming eligible to receive such care
sponsored.sum: Provides for due process procedures for persons who currently are placed in New York state education department approved out-of-state residential schools pursuant to the education law and the federal individuals with disabilities education act who have received an offer for transitional care or certain care prior to becoming eligible to receive such care.

sponsored.t: Makes annual state reimbursement for expenditures for certain approved community service projects by counties to be proportional to such county's share of elderly persons living in the state
sponsored.sum: Makes annual state reimbursement for expenditures for certain approved community service projects by counties to be proportional to such county's share of elderly persons living in the state.

sponsored.t: Requires rip current, rip tide and undertow curriculum or instruction
sponsored.sum: Enacts "Alexandra's law" to require school districts and charter schools to include in the curriculum or instruction teaching students how to recognize and react to rip currents, rip tides and undertows.

sponsored.t: Enacts the youth & teen internet safety and social media literacy act; repealer
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "youth & teen internet safety and social media literacy act"; directs the commissioner of education to provide technical assistance to school districts for the development of curricula for such study of courses which shall be age appropriate and developed according to the needs and abilities of pupils at successive grade levels in order to provide awareness, skills, information, and support to aid in the safe usage of the internet, social media, and artificial intelligence.

sponsored.t: Protects the personal information of candidates for public office
sponsored.sum: Requires the home address of candidates on nomination and designation petitions be redacted prior to the release of such documents to the public.

sponsored.t: Provides for expanded non-medical in-home services, non-institutional respite services, case management services, and ancillary services without a prescription or physician's order; repealer
sponsored.sum: Provides for expanded non-medical in-home services, non-institutional respite services, case management services, and ancillary services without a prescription or physician's order; repeals certain cost sharing requirements for such services.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 107 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Assembly Bill Number 7907, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the elder law, in relation to the provision of expanded non-medical in-home services, non-institutional respite services, case management services, and ancillary services without a prescription or physician's order; and to repeal certain provisions of such law relating thereto" NOT APPROVED This bill would clarify that agencies providing expanded non-medical in-home services (EISEP) and related services may do so without a prescription or physician's order. The bill would also eliminate the requirement for its recipients to share in the cost of the services. EISEP and similar services are valuable to those seniors who need them in order to continue residing at home. Current law does not require a physician order for these…

sponsored.t: Requires the commissioner of health to produce a report on the utilization and activity of the elderly pharmaceutical insurance coverage program
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of health to produce a report on the utilization and activity of the elderly pharmaceutical insurance coverage program, including future enrollment and program cost projections, and to publish such report and deliver the report to the governor, the temporary president of the senate, and the speaker of the assembly.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 74 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Assembly Bill Number 8090, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the elder law, in relation to requiring the commis- sioner of health to produce a report on the utilization and activ- ity of the elderly pharmaceutical insurance coverage program" NOT APPROVED This bill would require the Commissioner of Health to produce a report on the utilization and activity of the elderly pharmaceutical insurance coverage (EPIC) program. The Department of Health is already in the process of preparing an annual report with this information, which will be posted to its website in the second quarter of each calendar year. Therefore, no legislation is required to accomplish that goal. Therefore, I am constrained to veto this bill. The bill is disapproved. (signed) KATHY HOCHUL __________

sponsored.t: Extends provisions of the long term care ombudsman to assisted living facilities
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions of the long term care ombudsman access to assisted living facilities for two years from December 31, 2025 until December 31, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the effectiveness of provisions of law relating to permissible fees in connection with open end loans
sponsored.sum: Extends the effectiveness of provisions of law relating to permissible fees in connection with open end loans from June 30, 2025 until June 30, 2027.
